title: RTPS: string dissection, unicode improvements
description:
Add a local function `rtps_strlcpy()` which ensures its destination is
truncated on a clean unicode character boundary. Use this function for
getting the rtps type and topic names, where #19359 was triggered.
(Function may also be useful elsewhere in this dissector, but I'm
leaving that for other devs in order to reduce gold plating.)

Tweak `rtps_util_add_string()` to explicitly dissect the field
containing the string's length to make overall dissection more explicit.
Also rework `tvb_get_string_enc()`+`proto_tree_add_string()` to
`proto_tree_add_item()`.


(cherry picked from commit a35aa997ad7104c9173c0d6e38d6c00e8eedf19a)
